name: Tobi Lutke
what_they_do: Founder and CEO of Shopify; angel investor (personal capital, no fund).
stage: Seed and Series A per Signal; Hustle Fund profile says pre-seed, seed and early series. Idea-stage investing not confirmed by a primary source.
geography: Canada and US (Ottawa based); international bets exist
outreach_rule: unknown (no public DM rule, email, or form found)
notes: Thesis per Hustle Fund write-up: 'Back the infrastructure that makes builders more capable.' Example bets: Promptfoo (seed, with a16z), Foxglove, Perplexity, Neo Financial, General Fusion. Signal profile shows intro-path only. Handle @tobi also listed on aigrant.com mentor list.

name: Guillermo Rauch
what_they_do: Founder and CEO of Vercel; angel investor (personal capital).
stage: Pre-seed, seed, Series A (Signal.nfx). Secondary sources say he typically joins pre-seed and seed rounds.
geography: San Francisco Bay Area base; global (portfolio includes Supabase, Strapi)
outreach_rule: unknown (rauchg.com/about lists only the X handle; no DM rule or pitch form)
notes: 137 investments per Crunchbase. Example bets: Supabase, Replit, Warp, Convex, Perplexity, Scale AI. Strong open-source / devtools bias. Handle also confirmed on aigrant.com mentor list.

name: Nat Friedman & Daniel Gross (AI Grant)
what_they_do: Nat Friedman (ex-GitHub CEO) and Daniel Gross (ex-Pioneer, ex-Apple) fund AI Grant, an accelerator for pre-seed/seed AI startups. Day-to-day AI Grant is run by Hersh Desai and Lenny Bogdonoff. Both also angel invest personally.
stage: Pre-seed and seed AI startups; 'no credentials required', single founders accepted, companies that already raised may apply.
check_size: $250,000 on an uncapped, no-discount MFN SAFE, plus ~$600K in partner credits (Azure, OpenAI, Anthropic, Modal, etc.)
geography: Global; company must be or become a Delaware corporation
email_or_form: support@aigrant.org (general inquiries, from aigrant.com); application form only when a batch is open
outreach_rule: Apply through the batch application on aigrant.com when open. Status on 2026-09-02: 'Applications for Batch 4 are closed'. No date for a next batch is published.
notes: STATUS 2026-09-02: AI Grant Batch 4 applications are CLOSED; the site gives no next-batch date. Batches 1-4 portfolio listed on aigrant.com (Goodfire, Granola, Vapi, Inception Labs, etc.). Mentor list on aigrant.com includes @tobi, @levie, @amasad, @rauchg, @karpathy, @patrickc. Nat's own site nat.org has no contact or X link, so his handle is marked unverified. Daniel Gross handle verified via vcsheet (secondary). Nat and Daniel also joined Meta Superintelligence Labs in 2025 per press; not re-verified here.

name: Alexis Ohanian (Seven Seven Six / 776)
what_they_do: Reddit co-founder; founder and GP of Seven Seven Six, a seed-focused VC firm ('a technology company that deploys venture capital').
stage: Pre-seed through Series A/B (fund leads pre-seed rounds, e.g. Realtime $4M pre-seed)
email_or_form: unknown (sevensevensix.com is JS-rendered; no public pitch form or email could be read)
outreach_rule: unknown; no public cold-pitch rule found. Fund uses its 'Cerebro' software for founder intros.
notes: Fund is institutional, not a solo angel; checks are large for an idea-stage founder. Fund 1 $150M (2021), now >$1B AUM. Katelin Holloway is founding partner. vcsheet lists an obfuscated email that could not be read.

name: Lachy Groom (LGF)
what_they_do: Solo GP of LGF (Lachy Groom Fund, three funds: $49M, $110M, $250M); ex-Stripe product lead; co-founder of Physical Intelligence.
stage: Seed to later stage per Signal; secondary source (startupintros) says pre-seed to Series A. Pre-seed activity not confirmed by a primary source.
check_size: $100K-$10M, sweet spot $1M (Signal.nfx); pre-seed checks reported under $100K (secondary)
geography: San Francisco Bay Area base; US-centric
outreach_rule: unknown; Signal shows intro paths only
notes: Now largely focused on Physical Intelligence (robotics foundation models). Low public outreach surface; treat as warm-intro only.

name: Josh Kopelman (First Round Capital)
what_they_do: Founder and Partner at First Round Capital (pre-seed/seed VC); founded Half.com, Infonautics, TurnTide.
stage: Pre-seed and seed. Firm quote: 'We don't see divisions between angel, pre-seed and seed - we're interested across the board.' Kopelman backs startups in their first 24 months.
check_size: Firm: average initial $3.5M, range $1M-$7M; 'we've invested in rounds as small as $100,000'. vcsheet lists $750K-$4M for Kopelman.
geography: Primarily US (SF, NYC, Philadelphia offices); exceptions for international teams with US management
email_or_form: unknown (firstround.com publishes office addresses but no pitch email or form)
outreach_rule: Firm statement: 'A direct referral will get a quicker response, but don't be afraid to reach out cold. We invested in Iru after a cold email back in 2018.' No public email published.
notes: Institutional fund, leads rounds. Kopelman quote: 'great companies are built by great founders, not great investors.' Portfolio: Notion, Uber, Square, Roblox, Upstart, Flatiron Health.

name: Fabrice Grinda (FJ Labs)
what_they_do: Co-founder and Managing Partner of FJ Labs (NYC); serial marketplace founder (OLX, Aucland, Zingy). ~300 deals per year.
stage: Pre-seed, seed, Series A; emphasis on earlier stages
geography: Global: ~58% US/Canada, 25% Europe, 6% Brazil, 2% India, 9% other
email_or_form: https://pitchfabrice.fabricegrinda.com/ ('Pitch Me' tool on his own site)
outreach_rule: Use the 'Pitch Me' AI tool at pitchfabrice.fabricegrinda.com ('Get feedback on your startup'); team decides after two 1-hour calls over 1-2 weeks.
notes: ~70% of deals are marketplaces; explicitly avoids 'hardware, AI, space tech, biotech, etc. without a marketplace component'. Does not lead most rounds. Receives 100+ deals per week.

name: Paul Buchheit
what_they_do: Creator of Gmail; Managing Partner / Group Partner at Y Combinator; Crunchbase lists him as Co-Founder & GP of Standard Capital (not verifiable; standardcapital.com did not resolve on 2026-09-02).
stage: Pre-seed, seed, Series A/B (Signal.nfx lists pre-seed). Historically invested at idea stage as an early angel (Airbnb, Stripe, Reddit).
geography: San Francisco Bay Area / Mountain View
outreach_rule: unknown; most of his deal flow runs through Y Combinator (apply at ycombinator.com)
notes: ~187-202 investments on record. Best path for an idea-stage founder is a YC application. Standard Capital role could not be verified from a primary source.

name: Todd Goldberg & Rahul Vohra (Todd & Rahul's Angel Fund)
what_they_do: Two-person angel fund (now 'Todd & Rahul Capital'). Todd Goldberg founded Eventjoy (acq. Ticketmaster); Rahul Vohra founded Superhuman and Rapportive.
stage: Pre-seed and seed; 'We occasionally do post-seed and Series A rounds. We're more likely to invest if you've shipped a product and have some traction.'
outreach_rule: Fund site: 'we're always just an email or text away'. No formal form. Todd publishes hello@toddgoldberg.com.
notes: $50M+ deployed into 120+ startups. Portfolio: Mercury, Supabase, Placer.ai, Writer, WorkOS, Hightouch, Hex, Eight Sleep, Ashby. Prefer shipped product with some traction, so pure idea stage is a weaker fit. vcsheet shows @toddg777 but Todd's own site links twitter.com/toddgoldberg; own site wins.

name: Aaron Levie
what_they_do: Co-founder and CEO of Box; angel investor (personal capital).
stage: Pre-seed, seed, Series A/B (Signal.nfx lists pre-seed)
check_size: $5K-$50K, sweet spot $25K (Signal.nfx, secondary); Hustle Fund write-up says $25K-$500K, ~$150K preferred (secondary; conflicting)
outreach_rule: unknown (no public DM rule, email, or form found)
notes: Thesis: bottom-up adoption with enterprise monetization; 'must-have solutions'. Example bets: Plaid, Airtable, Figma. Very active poster on X. Handle listed on aigrant.com mentor list.

name: Dharmesh Shah
what_they_do: Co-founder and CTO of HubSpot; angel investor in 90+ startups (Coinbase, Okta, AngelList, Gusto, Stack Overflow).
stage: Pre-seed and seed (secondary sources); writes checks with 'no due diligence' and a yes/no within 24 hours
outreach_rule: Explicit: on 'how to reach him' he writes 'Honestly, you shouldn't.' 'Not a single one was the result of a cold outreach or pitch. Especially over social media like LinkedIn or twitter.' Deal flow comes from referrals, YC, and AngelList.
notes: Rules: 'No calls, no meetings', 'No due diligence', 'No follow-on investments', 'No board seats or advisory roles', 'Always side with the founders'. Invests in products he or someone he knows would use. Cold DMs are explicitly discouraged.

name: Eric Bahn (Hustle Fund)
what_they_do: Co-founder and GP of Hustle Fund (with Elizabeth Yin, Shiyan Koh); pre-seed fund that writes '$150K in hilariously early pre-seed software startups'. Not a solo GP.
outreach_rule: Apply through the Typeform on hustlefund.vc. 'You don't need perfect metrics, a famous network, or a 47-slide deck.'
notes: Judges founders on week-over-week execution speed. Decisions fast (Elizabeth Yin: 48 hours). Runs Angel Squad (2,000+ angels).

name: Elizabeth Yin (Hustle Fund)
what_they_do: Co-founder and GP of Hustle Fund; ex-500 Startups partner; prolific writer on fundraising. Not a solo GP.
stage: Pre-seed; 'writes $25K pre-product checks' (vcsheet); own blog: 'I care less about how developed your product is ... than my peers.'
outreach_rule: Apply via the Hustle Fund form; she screens 1,000+ companies with automation and decides in ~48 hours.
notes: Team weighted over product. Very active on X about pre-seed fundraising tactics. Same form as Eric Bahn entry.

check_size: 'We invest $500K to $2M. Roughly once per month.'
email_or_form: Deck submission form at the bottom of https://www.julian.capital/ (custom form: email, LinkedIn, company, valuation)
